proposal.diagnosis: cartStore checks total > 50 strictly instead of >= 50 for free shipping, and Cart.tsx hardcodes $5.00 display instead of referencing shippingFee.
proposal.rationale: Fix defective logic in src/store/cartStore.ts, src/components/Cart.tsx
proposal.unifiedDiff: --- a/src/store/cartStore.ts +++ b/src/store/cartStore.ts @@ -62,1 +62,1 @@ - shipping: () => (get().total() > 50 || get().items.length === 0 ? 0 : 5), + shipping: () => (get().total() >= 50 || get().items.length === 0 ? 0 : 5), --- a/src/components/Cart.tsx +++ b/src/components/Cart.tsx @@ -93,1 +93,1 @@ - $5.00 + ${shippingFee.toFixed(2)}
